analytics.name: Analytic 1885
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a process on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Windows host making direct native Operating System (OS) Application Programming Interface (API) calls that bypass the normal ICS vendor Software Development Kit (SDK) abstraction layer -- direct CreateFile calls against raw device paths, DeviceIoControl calls to ICS hardware driver handles -- from a process not a recognized vendor application. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

tuning.description: Allowlist of processes expected to interact with ICS hardware/protocols.

log_sources.name: edr:Syscall
log_sources.channel: DeviceIoControl or raw socket creation to Industrial Control Systems (ICS) protocol port from process not in authorized ICS applications, bypassing documented vendor Software Development Kit (SDK) call pattern

analytics.name: Analytic 2138
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a process making direct ioctl or mmap syscalls against Industrial Control System (ICS) hardware device files, bypassing the vendor's documented Application Programming Interface (API) layer, from a process not in the recognized ICS application list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

tuning.description: Allowlist of processes expected to interact with ICS hardware/protocols.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): ioctl or mmap syscall against Industrial Control Systems (ICS) hardware device file from process not in authorized ICS applications

analytics.name: Analytic 2183
analytics.guidance: Use an OT-capable protocol decoder to monitor SNMP requests/responses and identify access to vendor-internal or undocumented OIDs from sources outside the approved NMS inventory, especially SET operations or unusual walks against control-network infrastructure. This is network-protocol observation, not OS API execution; require decoded SNMP transaction content or equivalent packet inspection.

tuning.description: Allowlist of processes expected to interact with ICS hardware/protocols.

log_sources.name: otids:ProtocolDecoder
log_sources.channel: SNMP request/response decoder: OID, operation type, source/destination; flag access to undocumented/vendor-internal OIDs from non-approved NMS sources

analytics.name: Analytic 2246
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol messages using vendor-specific or undocumented function codes that access device hardware registers directly rather than through the normal ICS application layer, from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

tuning.description: Allowlist of processes expected to interact with ICS hardware/protocols.

log_sources.name: NSM:Content
log_sources.channel: reserved or vendor-specific function code accessing device registers directly from source not in engineering workstation list
